inputConditions.condition: The matrix is in 3-CNF if the last quantifier is existential and in 3-DNF if it is universal.

parameter: Treewidth t of the primal graph

reader.boundContext: Here q is the fixed number of quantifier blocks, t is the primal treewidth, and n is the number of variables in the matrix. T(q,x) is a tower of q powers of two with x at the top, so T(1,x)=2^x and T(2,x)=2^(2^x).
reader.parameter: The treewidth t of the primal graph. Its vertices are the variables, and two variables are adjacent if they occur together in a clause or term.
